convention: all energies PER-SITE (= 2 * per-bond on the square lattice); Jx=Jy=Jz=1.0, spin 1/2, sublattice-rotated AFM Heisenberg
reference_is: EXACT finite-torus energy (NOT CTMRG); CTMRG is unreliable for structured tensors
rationale: PEPSKit CTMRG ALSO diverges from the exact torus reference for the structured tensor (as the hand-rolled JAX CTMRG did). CTMRG-based PEPS is NOT trustworthy for structured tensors; this blocks the PEPS carrier path and argues for the exact-contraction / spinor route instead.
honest_note: Both CTMRG engines disagree with the exact torus AND with each other for this structured tensor: exact torus L6 = -0.061694 per-site; JAX-CTMRG = -0.6297439490028554 ; PEPSKit-CTMRG (chi32) = 0.499694. The two CTMRGs diverge in OPPOSITE directions. This is the load-bearing finding.
